chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from Fatḥ, the mawlā of al-Zurārī, who said:
I heard Abū ʿAlī ibn Muṭahhar mention that he had indeed seen him عليه السلام, and he described his stature to him.

key_terms.أَبَا عَلِيِّ: Abū ʿAlī; the named individual being reported from
key_terms.بْنَ مُطَهَّرٍ: ibn Muṭahhar; identifying the narrator mentioned in the report
key_terms.رَآهُ: he saw him; indicating claimed direct sighting
key_terms.سَمِعْتُ: I heard; indicating direct auditory reception from the speaker
key_terms.قَدَّهُ: his stature or height; a description of physical build
key_terms.مَوْلَى: client/freedman/affiliate; describing Fatḥ’s relation to al-Zurārī

ai.seo_question: Who were among those reported to have seen him عليه السلام in al-Kāfī?
ai.summary: This report records a transmission from a person who mentioned having seen him عليه السلام and described his physical stature. It serves as a brief biographical notice within the chapter naming those who saw him عليه السلام.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Fat’h, a slave of Al Zarary who said,
‘I heard Abu Ali Bin Mut’har mention that he had seen him<sup>asws</sup>, and described his<sup>asws</sup> tallness to him’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Fath, Mawla (slave) of al-Zurari who has said the following.
“I heard abu Ali ibn Mutahhar saying that has seen him (the twelfth Imam) and would describe his (Imam’s) figure.”
